entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Established 25 years ago in the wake of the East Timor conflict, Headquarters Joint Forces New Zealand (HQJFNZ) was created to centralise the command of joint operations across the New Zealand Defence Force.

Just months after HQJFNZ became operational in 2001, the September 11 attacks in the United States changed the global security landscape. HQJFNZ responded quickly, deploying personnel to Afghanistan.

In the two and a half decades that have followed, HQJFNZ has been at the forefront of our Defence Force involvement in global conflicts, humanitarian disasters and political unrest.

Read the full story ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/JFNZ-25
